summary: Skills required to perform the job; the servicing vehicle's skills must be a superset.
range: Array of positive integers (each > 0); may be empty (any vehicle qualifies).
businessRules: Assignable iff job.skills subset of vehicle.skills.

skills defines: Define the skills needed to complete the job. This attribute supports multidimensional skills allowing users to add multiple skills. Read more about the behavior of this attribute in the [Multi-Dim…
Each element in skills must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.skills. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Higher priority jobs are serviced first; ties break by job ID order.
Rule: Vehicle must have all skills required by the job (exact match, case-sensitive).
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
Skills matching is case-sensitive and exact. Vehicle must have ALL skills required by job.
testingGuidance: Positive: job skills [2] served by vehicle skills [1,2].
Infeasible: job needs a skill no vehicle has -> unassigned (skill reason).
Boundary: empty job skills -> any vehicle.
Interaction: Combination: tight capacity + one high-priority + one low-priority job competing for the last slot -> high-priority assigned, low-priority unassigned.
Interaction: Combination: high-priority job whose only skill is unavailable on any vehicle -> still unassigned despite priority.
Interaction: Interaction: two jobs with equal priority; one has outsourcing_cost 100, other 50 -> cost-based job assigned first.
Interaction: Infeasible: job needs skill 3, no vehicle has 3 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Positive: job needs [2]; only the vehicle whose skills include 2 serves it.
